description:
[Wicked Sanity] Fetch a previously run check by its check_id (returned by sanity_check / sanity_check_batch). x402 or SANITY_API_KEY like the other Sanity calls.

Use when you want to re-read an earlier check by its check_id. Not for running a new check.

Behavior: read-only.

check_id.description: The check_id from an earlier sanity_check result.

name: sanity_get_check
